BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to primary election voters' pamphlets; amending RCW29A.32.010; and repealing RCW 29A.32.036.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.32.010 and 2003 c 111 s 801 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of state shall((, whenever at least one statewidemeasure or office is scheduled to appear on the general electionballot,)) print and distribute a voters' pamphlet for the generalelection every year. Subject to the availability of amountsappropriated for this specific purpose, the secretary of state shallprint and distribute a voters' pamphlet for the primary in each evennumbered year. The secretary of state shall distribute the voters' pamphlet toeach household in the state, to public libraries, and to any otherlocations he or she deems appropriate. The secretary of state shallalso produce taped or Braille transcripts of the voters' pamphlet,publicize their availability, and mail without charge a copy to anyperson who requests one. p. 1 SSB 5637 The secretary of state may make the material required to bedistributed by this chapter available to the public in electronic form.The secretary of state may provide the material in electronic form tocomputer bulletin boards, print and broadcast news media, communitycomputer networks, and similar services at the cost of reproduction ortransmission of the data.
RCW 29A.32.036 (Even year primary contents)and 2004 c 271 s 122 are each repealed.
